description:
Arogya Sanjeevani Policy is a standard health insurance policy required to be offered by all General and Health insurers. Insurers are now allowed to offer a minimum sum insured less than Rs.1 lakh and the maximum sum insured greater than Rs.5 lakh.  Features and benefits of the policy have been explained in the video. The video is only for informational purposes. You can take advice from your insurance agent before making the final decision of buying a health insurance policy. 

Please subscribe to our youtube channel: https://www.youtube.com/PankajMathpal?sub_confirmation=1

Here is a video on Corona Kavach and Corona Rakshak:  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0jiMus-77BY&t=130s
